in_marathi.name: Upasana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Upasana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Upasana' meaning 'a worship, an offering, a form of reverence'. Upasana is a significant name in Hindu culture, symbolizing devotion, reverence, and respect towards the divine.
